description: This Java source file defines a final class 'HttpsEnsuringDirective' which provides an Akka HTTP directive to enforce or ensure that proxied requests are made via HTTPS. It includes logic for redirecting or rejecting non-HTTPS requests, configurable via HttpConfig, with header inspection to determine protocol enforcement.

classes.name: HttpsEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A class providing an Akka HTTP directive to enforce HTTPS connections for proxied requests, with options for redirecting or rejecting non-HTTPS requests based on configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of HttpsEnsuringDirective with provided HttpConfig settings.

methods.name: ensureHttps
methods.description: Wraps a given route to enforce HTTPS, either redirecting or rejecting requests that are not HTTPS based on configuration.
